title: NEW MSFS 2024 Activities! Epic Landings & World Tour (PC)
description:
pril 26, 2026 brings another Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update, and this week’s must‑have activity is the 8 Legs World Tour! Whether you want to sharpen your skills with Epic Landings or travel the globe, this PC marketplace update has something for every pilot.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: Advanced Challenged - Epic Landings - vol 1 (Precision landing mission pack)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 8 Legs world tour challenge (A legendary 8-leg journey across the sim)

🕒 Chapters
00:00 - Start
00:30 - Perfect Flight - Advanced Challenges - Epic Landings - vol 1
01:19 - Perfect Flight - 8 Legs world tour challenge

If you enjoyed this update, make sure to like, subscribe, and drop a comment below — which of these Perfect Flight missions are you picking up this week?
Thanks for watching and happy flying!

✈️ See you in the skies!
